About me

Motherhood changed how I see light and love

For twelve years I have quietly documented families as they grow, capturing the in-between moments that become your most treasured memories.

Learn More

What I offer

Maternity sessions, newborn portraiture, family gatherings, milestone celebrations. Each session unfolds naturally in your home or a meaningful outdoor location.

Maternity Sessions

Capturing the gentle transition from motherhood to motherhood, focusing on the tender connection between you and your growing child.

Intimate, soft-focused portraits that celebrate the first days of life, using natural light to highlight delicate features.
